title: Module-specific ablations and their observed signatures

quantities.loss_change_nats: paired loss of the ablated arm minus the complete module on the held-out contrast (nats; positive means the module lowers the loss)
quantities.warning_lead_change_depths: change of the warning lead (controlled depths between the first warning and the onset of deterioration), ablated minus complete
quantities.false_safe_rate_change: change of the false-safe rate (executed decisions marked safe whose paired loss increased), ablated minus complete
quantities.risk_rmse_change: change of the held-out RMSE of the one-step risk model (nats), ablated minus complete
quantities.action_entropy_change: change of the entropy of the executed action mix (nats), ablated minus complete
quantities.innovation_rmse: held-out innovation RMSE of the observer variant
quantities.clean_score_change: change of the official score on supported inputs, ablated minus complete
quantities.worst_harm_change_nats: change of the worst per-unit paired loss harm, ablated minus complete (nats)
quantities.retained_effect_fraction: effect of the ablated arm as a fraction of the complete module's effect against q_C
quantities.cost_fraction: added cost of the ablated arm over q_C as a fraction of the complete module's added cost over q_C

modules.label: spectral bands
modules.failure_targeted: predictive deterioration not visible in confidence
modules.comparison: full sensors vs no bands/scrambled bands
modules.removal_rule: remove if no incremental warning or policy value
modules.runtime: unsupported: cross_morse.core.MeasurementBank requires exactly three distinct bands of the six-window bank (sensor.bands), and the Lean profile zeros the band-power, source-alignment and reachability coordinates together, so neither a band-only deletion nor a band scramble at matched capacity is configurable

modules.label: source alignment
modules.runtime: unsupported: no configuration key removes the three source-alignment coordinates of the measurement vector alone

modules.label: confidence sensors
modules.runtime: unsupported: entropy and margin are fixed coordinates of the measurement vector and also define the support strata

modules.label: transport history
modules.runtime: unsupported: accumulated mass and expected range are fixed measurement and observer-design coordinates

modules.label: observer
modules.runtime: unsupported: the runtime fits only the conditioned observer (cross_morse.learning.ConditionedObserver); raw, EMA and global observers have no configuration key

modules.label: radius uncertainty
modules.removal_rule: classify as one-step if radius fails
modules.runtime: post-hoc: radius-minus-one-step contrasts on D_confirm (confirm/decision.json); loss change = minus the contrast mean

modules.label: sequence risk
modules.removal_rule: remove replanning label if no value
modules.runtime: post-hoc: on runs whose deployed rule is MPC-RH, the nested D_select effect of the one-step route (critic only, no transition, stage or terminal model) minus that of the deployed MPC-RH configuration at the same profile and ensemble size (select/decision.json)

modules.label: recovery type
modules.runtime: unsupported: the source reset A8 and last-safe recovery A9 are fixed registry actions and cross_morse.policies.recovery_action has no configuration key

modules.label: comparator branch
modules.runtime: unsupported: the released runner has no serving-time input gate, so the comparator branch cannot be switched

modules.label: Full/Lean profile
modules.runtime: post-hoc: Full-minus-Lean retained-fraction contrasts on D_confirm (confirm/decision.json; Lean retains one minus the contrast mean) and the added cost of the Lean predecessor over q_C as a fraction of the Full rule's (select/candidates.json)

notes: Rows with dataset 'pooled' hold a pooled value; per-dataset rows are summarised as a range. Produced by `python -B scripts/run_sweep.py collect --sweep module_ablations --parent <run> ... --output <sweep>` for the three modules the released runtime supports (radius uncertainty, sequence risk, Full/Lean profile), then `python -B scripts/export_sweep_records.py --results <sweep>/results.json --hardware ... --period ...`. The other seven modules need runtime support that the release does not have; each module's 'runtime' field states what is missing.
